data.title: 加藤惠 · 周末服装店的认真挑选·「这两件衣服……伦也君觉得哪一件更好看呢」
data.description: 【商业街服装店试衣区·周末】在琳琅满目的衣架前，惠手里拿着两件不同风格的夏日连衣裙在身前比划。低头认真看着吊牌与面料搭配，没有摆拍的做作，尽显普通女高纯真自然的生活审美。
data.action: 身前比划连衣裙认真低头比对，马尾微晃，眼神专注沉吟
data.lighting: 精品店暖色射灯与镜面柔和反光
data.camera: medium shot, holding clothes, shopping date, natural expression
data.promptProse: Megumi Kato stands thoughtfully in a brightly lit boutique clothing store on a weekend afternoon, her brown hair tied up in a neat ponytail. She holds two contrasting summer dresses up against her figure with quiet seriousness, glancing down between the price tags and fabrics with honest, unpretentious consideration. Soft pastel garments on racks surround her in warm golden store lighting. Medium shot, crisp line art, elegant boutique bokeh, detailed background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
